Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:43151
Court No. - 12

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 4927 of 2024
Applicant :- Amar Singh

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Alok Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Saurabh Lavania,J.
1. Notice upon opposite party No.2 is sufficient.

However, no one appeared on behalf of opposite
party No.2.

2. Heard.
3.

The present bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant-Amar Singh in Case Crime
No.554 of 2022, under Section 376 I.P.C. & 3/4 Pocso Act, 2012, Police Station- Fatehpur, District-
Barabanki, with the prayer to enlarge him on bail.

4.  While pressing the present bail application, learned counsel for the applicant states that the applicant has been falsely implicated in this case and he is in jail since 07.10.2022, without committing any crime.

1 5.

It is further stated that applicant is having criminal history of one case, which has been sufficiently explained in para No.14 of the rejoinder affidavit and the same has not been disputed from the side opposite/ learned A.G.A.
6.

It is next stated that before the trial Court, opposite party No.2/ victim has already been examined and she has been declared hostile and in the cross examination by the prosecution, with the permission of the Court, nothing could be elicited.
7. It is further submitted that a perusal of the medical opinion indicates that it also does not support the story of the prosecution.

The statement of the doctor recorded before the trial Court as P.W.3 also indicates that no injury was found external or internal to attract the offense under Section 376 IPC and POCSO Act and the injuries which were found, as per the doctor himself, could be sustained if someone falls down on the ground or hard and blunt object.

8. It is further submitted that considering the aforesaid aspect of the case including the period of incarceration, the stage of the trial as also the statement of the victim and the doctor before the trial Court, the applicant, who has criminal history of one case which has been explained in the rejoinder affidavit, is entitled to be released on bail.
In case of being enlarged on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate in trial and would also not influence the prosecution witnesses.

9. Learned A.G.A. for the State opposed the prayer for grant of bail but could not dispute the aforesaid particularly the statement of the victim, medical opinion as also the statement of the doctor concerned.

10. Considering the rival submissions of learned counsel for parties, material available on record including medical opinion and period of incarceration as also the statement of the victim and the statement of the doctor and the submission of counsel for the applicant to the effect that while on bail in this case, the applicant would not commit any crime/offense nor he would try to tamper the evidence or influence the witnesses in any manner whatsoever it may be and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court finds force in the argument of the application and is of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
10. Let applicant-Amar Singh be released on bail in aforesaid Case Crime, on his furnishing personal bond to the satisfaction of the court concerned forthwith.

Applicant is also directed to furnish two reliable sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:-
(1) Applicant will not try to influence the witnesses or tamper with the evidence of the case or otherwise misuse the liberty of bail.
(2) Applicant will fully cooperate in expeditious disposal of the case and shall not seek any adjournment on the dates fixed for evidence when witnesses are present in the Court.
